turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
to start:



Put 2–3 wax melt bears in the warmer’s silicone dish.


Turn on the warmer and choose a 3-, 6-, or 9-hour timer setting. Starting with 3 hours lets you see how you like the scent before running it longer.


When you want to change scents, let the wax cool and solidify completely. Then flex the silicone dish to pop it out—no scraping needed.



The three scents in the pack are Fresh Cotton, Calming Lavender, and Lemon Verbena, so you can try them one at a time to find your favorite.

How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
For the Signature Wax Melt Warmer and Fresh Collection 3-Pack, here’s a good way to start:
Put 2–3 wax melt bears in the warmer’s silicone dish.
